title: In the Sweet By and By
alsoKnownAs: There’s a Land That Is Fairer Than Day
description: In the Sweet By and By in Tonic Solfa to SWEET BY AND BY: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the 3 verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: Sanford Fillmore Bennett wrote the words and Joseph Philbrick Webster the music, both in 1868.
underlay: There’s a land that is fair-er than day, And by faith we can see it a-far; For the Fa-ther waits o-ver the way, To pre-pare us a dwell-ing place there. In the sweet by and by, We shall meet on that beau-ti-ful shore; In the sweet by and by, We shall meet on that beau-ti-ful shore.

lines: There’s a land that is fairer than day,
And by faith we can see it afar;
For the Father waits over the way,
To prepare us a dwelling place there.

verses.label: Refrain
lines: In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on that beautiful shore;
In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on that beautiful shore.
We shall sing on that beautiful shore
The melodious songs of the blest,
And our spirits shall sorrow no more,
Not a sigh for the blessings of rest.
We will offer our tribute of praise,
For the glorious gifts of His love,
And the blessings that hallow our days.
